name: What Happens to Dreams Deferred? - Special Screening // MIX CPH 2024
description:
From finding ourselves in our youth to getting out in the “real world” we are always exploring new ways of being - alone and together, especially in an unwelcoming or violent society. Existence is always interlinked and communal; we don't make it alone. Complete strangers, lovers, friends, entire neighborhoods, or even people who stay with us beyond life; we come together to walk further, to support, to witness, to belong. This program comprised of different QTIBIPOC stories is for you, for building with us.

+ QTIBIPOC stands for "Queer, Trans, Intersex / Black, Indigenous, People of Colour".

About the special screening:
Films can bring people together, spark conversations, and strengthen communities. We understand this, which is why we're creating spaces for the audience to experience that magic collectively! Once again, MIX COPENHAGEN is hosting a special screenings for the QTIBIPOC community. The screening is exclusively for members of the community. The initiative seeks to create a space where cinemagoers can see themselves represented not only on the screen but also among the audience. The underlying idea is to unite a marginalised queer community, allowing them to enjoy films together and have a great time.

The screening is free of charge and exclusively for people who are racialised (Black/Indigenous/People of Colour) and identify as Queer, Trans, Intersex. To receive your ticket, you can contact us by mail: specialscreenings@mixcopenhagen.dk

About the short films: 
>> Welcome to Celibacy Club
Campbell Moore / USA / 2023 / 16 min / English without subtitles
A coming-of-age short film about identifying as asexual in a world of sex and sensuality.

>> My Heart Is Going to Explode
Jung In-hyuk / South Korea / 2023 / 20 min / Korean with English subtitles
Soojin is taken on a chaotic journey that tests the strength of her heart. In this B-grade humour short full of invading aliens, sci-fi, action-romance, and clichés, a UFO appears in the sky over Seoul. Together with the green-lit girl she met last night, she strives to save the city.

>> Beach
Anisha Sharma/ India / 2023 / 15 min / Hindi with English subtitles
Karan is a trans man who has recently undergone gender-affirming surgery, and going to the beach shirtless has been a dream and act of liberation for him. His supportive cis friend Aditya, who always stands up for him, accompanies him on this journey. Will Karan have the courage to go shirtless on the beach? Will he achieve his dream and feel liberated?

>> Apartment 605
Bianca Catbagan / The Philippines / 2023 / 7 min / English, French and Tagalog with subtitles for the Tagalog
Mika packs up their late father’s apartment when they are interrupted by the buzzer. Over the course of a conversation separated by the building’s intercom, we learn of the visitor's connection with the apartment's owner, Mika’s estranged father.

>> MnM
Twiggy Pucci Garçon / USA / 2023 / 22 min / English without subtitles
MnM is an exuberant portrait of chosen sisters Mermaid and Milan, two emerging runway divas in the drag ballroom community. Celebrating their joy, siblinghood, and unapologetic personas, the film explores the power and beauty of being non-binary in a community that prizes gender ‘realness’.

>> Unless We Dance 
Hanz Rippe Gabriele, Fernanda Pineda Palencia / Colombia / 2023 / 15 min / Spanish with English subtitles
In Quibdó, Columbia, Bonays and hundreds of young people come together through dance as their act of resilience to the violence of the city.

name: OPEN STUDIO MORNING: Man Yau – FAIR Resident
description:
On Monday 25 November 09-10AM we invite you to join us for morning coffees and croissants at the Open Studio of FAIR resident Man Yau in Atelier # 16 at FABRIKKEN for Kunst og Design.

Man Yau (b. 1991) is a sculptor based in Helsinki, Finland. Yau holds master's degrees from both the Aalto University of Art and Design, and the Academy of Fine Arts, University of the Arts Helsinki. Her artistic practice is a material-led exploration on the topic of exoticization, from both a personal and historical perspective. Yau works with sculptures and installations, where she borrows shapes from recognizable objects and situations, such as Chinoiserie-style aesthetics, porcelain vases, and silk ribbons. Central to her work are the values and history associated with everyday objects, and by reshaping them, Yau explores notions of values in racial, gendered, and commonly accepted narratives.


Yau explains the work during the residency this way: “During my residency at FABRIKKEN I focused on making new works for my current exhibition at Temnikova & Kasela Temnikova & Kasela Gallery in Tallinn, Estonia. The Copenhagen architecture and the city’s countless statues highlighting the history of Denmark, inspired me to create new works. The works created during the residency are called ‘Artemis’, referring to the ancient Greek goddess, known as the goddess of hunting, who is one of the rare few whose god-like status doesn't come from stereotypical female traits such as beauty, seduction or ability to give birth.”

At the event you will get the chance to meet Man Yau and see some of her work and proces during her three-month Residency in Copenhagen.

The morning Open Studio is open to everyone and free to attend.

The FAIR residency programme is a research programme that welcomes visual artists based in the Nordic and Baltic countries in three-months residencies. The programme comprises active mentoring and curatorial support.


FAIR 2024 is kindly supported by The Finnish Cultural Foundation and The Danish Arts Foundation.


Cover photo: Man Yau: Artemis (arrows), 2024. Porcelain, glaze, Kyudo arrow, steel. 116 x 6 x 6 cm. From the duo exhibition “Saline Binds” together with Eetu Sihvonen, Temnikova & Kasela Gallery, Tallinn (EW) 26.10.2024–5.01.2025.�Credits: Exhibition photography by Stanislav Stepashko.

name: Olla Común 🥘 - South American Community Kitchen
description:
******ENGLISH BELOW******

Hola a todes!

Les esperamos el jueves 28 de Noviembre a las 18.00 en el primer piso de La Casa del Pueblo para la Olla Comunitaria de cada mes. La comida se sirve a las 18.30 masomenos

Como esta sera la ultima Olla del año y el frio medio que ya esta empezando, les vamos a cocinar un Aji de Fideo Boliviano.(tambien conocido como Fideos Uchu). Como siempre veganizaremos el plato.

Este mes aun no sabemos si habra un evento como una charla o algo pero les avisaremos pronto!

El dinero que se recaudo la ultima vez sera enviado a Bolivia para apoyar el trabjo de lxs bomberxs que luchan contra el fuego apocaliptico en el este del pais.

Esta Olla, mandaremos el dinero recaudado a Mundo Verde (https://www.instagram.com/mundoverderdm) una organizacion de Palenque en Colombia que conserva los ecosistemas de la region y organizan programas educacionales de conservacion y proteccion al medio ambiente para niñes

Se puede pagar con cash y tambien con MobilePay 🙂

Nos vemos!!

Una cosita mas!! El 30 habra una fiesta para recaudar fondos para Crisis Mirror https://dukop.dk/en/event/crisis-mirror-support-party/7144/  y algunes del equipo de cocina haremos la comida ahi tambien! ;)

-----------------------------------
Hi everyone!

Join us this Thursday *28th of Nov* for the monthly Olla Comun at 18.00 at the first floor of FolketsHus. Food is served at around 18.30

It's the last Olla and its getting cold so we'll make an Andean classic from Bolivia, Aji de Fideo (also known as Fideos Uchu)

We will let you know if an event like a talk or something will happen, stay tuned!

This time we will send the money to Mundo Verde, a group of people from a palenque, afrodescendent community by the North-West Caribbean coast, and have been working now for more than 20 years on recovering their mangrooves and implementing an educational program on ecosystem conservation for kids.

See you on Thursday! For donations we take cash and MobilePay

Also!! On the 30th it's Crisis Mirror's support party https://dukop.dk/en/event/crisis-mirror-support-party/7144/ and some of the kitchen team will be making the food for that event as well ;)

name: Opening of Decembristerne: Extralys
description:
Join us for the opening of Extralys (Extra Light), presented by the artist association Decembristerne.
In this captivating exhibition, all standard electric lighting at Den Frie will be turned off, allowing the participating artists to explore the physical, sensory, and metaphorical dimensions of light in diverse and imaginative ways.

The exhibition opens on Friday November 29, 16-19. We look forward to seeing you there!
